```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ENTITY baseURI "http://example.org/entities/">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://example.org/external.ent">
  %ext;
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/ns/catalog">
  <group id="g1">
    <item id="i1">
      <name>Test Entity Handling</name>
      <description>Testing general entity expansion and SYSTEM identifiers.</description>
    </item>
  </group>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (title, content)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<doc>
  <section>
    <title>Notation Test</title>
    <content>Checking internal DTD validation with element declarations and notation definitions.</content>
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <header>
    <title>XInclude Stress Test</title>
  </header>
  <body>
    <xi:include href="subdoc.xml" parse="xml">
      <xi:fallback>
        <error>Fallback content triggered because subdoc.xml is missing.</error>
      </xi:fallback>
    </xi:include>
  </body>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root>
  <!-- CDATA section containing XML-like markup to verify parser handling of raw blocks -->
  <data><![CDATA[
    <node>
      <child attr="val">Text inside CDATA with < and & characters.</child>
    </node>
  ]]></data>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root>
  <p:data xmlns:p="http://example.com/ns/p" p:attr="test">
    <p:item>Namespace prefix handling and attribute normalization test.</p:item>
  </p:data>
</root>
```
